subject: MAP: security handoff — evidence routing & archive paths (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)
messages:
From: Timothy Rhodes <tim.rhodes@spiralstack.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Nadia Gomez <nadia.gomez@spiralstack.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff — evidence owners + data retention questions

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — SpiralStack liked the latency profile and the private deployment options. Our security team asked me to kick off the Mutual Action Plan and route a few evidence/retention questions before we lock the timeline. High level asks:

- Do you have a canonical list of SOC 2 artefacts we can point to (control owners and expected delivery dates)?
- For SIG/CAIQ items, who is the primary contact at Redwood for technical evidence (e.g., network diagrams, encryption at rest keys)?
- DPA: we have two carveouts to discuss around EU data residency and deletion guarantees (30 vs 90 days). Is there flexibility for a 30-day purge on delegated artifacts?

We'd like to map these to a two-week evidence sprint in Apr if possible. Can you propose owners and a short timeline?

—Tim
Director of Security, SpiralStack

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Timothy Rhodes <tim.rhodes@spiralstack.com>
Cc: Nadia Gomez <nadia.gomez@spiralstack.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evidence owners + data retention questions

Hi Tim —

Appreciate the clear list. I've sketched a compact MAP and routing plan below and attached an evidence-routing spreadsheet that maps asks to owners and target dates. Summary here:

Proposed owners and sprint cadence (two-week sprint starting 2027-04-05):
- SOC 2 artefacts (system descriptions, control narratives, evidence exports): Kimberly Park (Security Operations) — delivery: 2027-04-12
- SIG/CAIQ technical evidence (network diagram, encryption configuration, key management): Jonas Weber (Platform Security) — delivery: 2027-04-09
- DPA carveouts + legal wording: Lauren Bishop (Legal/product liaison) with input from your GC — target redline by 2027-04-07

DPA / data retention note: Redwood's standard is 90 days for delegated backups and archival retention; for production-level deletion (customer deletions + tombstone sweep) our SLA supports 30 days if we include an embargo and an HSM-backed deletion confirmation. I can propose a narrow carveout (30-day operational purge for production data) paired with a retention escrow for a 90-day raw backup window — that would give SpiralStack the operational behavior you want while keeping an auditable backup for legal/regulatory windows.

Requested from SpiralStack before the sprint:
- List of prioritized SIG controls you want us to evidence (top 20 preferred)
- Any specific data residency requirements (single-region EU, or multi-region with geo-fencing)
- POC contact for encryption/key validation (name + contact)

Attachments: evidence-routing-sheet.xlsx (maps each ask to owner + sample evidence filename), soc2-internal-snapshot.pdf (recent readiness snapshot), draft-dpa-carveouts.docx (starting language for your counsel).

If that looks good I'll lock owners and create a shared Jira (I've added the link in related_links) and we can run the two-week sprint.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Manager, Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Nadia Gomez <nadia.gomez@spiralstack.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Timothy Rhodes <tim.rhodes@spiralstack.com>, Elliot Park <elliot.park@spiralstack.com>
Date: 2027-03-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evidence owners + data retention questions

Thanks Lauren — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- Priority SIG controls: we will send the top 18 by 2027-03-24 (Nadia to provide).
- Data residency: SpiralStack requires EU-only residency for customer PII (single-region). Can Redwood support a VPC/private deployment pinned to eu-west-1 for the customer environment? If so we need a short note describing region controls that we can include in our SOC review.
- DPA carveout ask: our legal prefers a hard 30-day deletion for customer-initiated permanent deletes. The escrow idea is acceptable — can you confirm how deletion confirmations are logged (audit trail) and whether we can receive an event webhook when purge is complete?

We are also tracking procurement timing — we want the MAP sprint completed and evidence in hand before procurement issues PO. Proposed procurement milestone: PO by 2027-04-22 conditional on MAP closure.

—Nadia
Head of Security Programs, SpiralStack

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Nadia Gomez <nadia.gomez@spiralstack.com>, Timothy Rhodes <tim.rhodes@spiralstack.com>, Elliot Park <elliot.park@spiralstack.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-23T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evidence owners + data retention questions

Nadia / Tim — quick update and answers so you can lock the procurement cadence: 

- EU-only VPC: yes — Redwood Private supports pinning workloads to eu-west-1. Jonas will draft a short region-control note (network egress, logging placement, and key locality) and upload to the evidence folder by 2027-03-25.
- 30-day customer deletion: we can do operational 30-day permanent-delete behavior for customer-initiated deletes. Implementation details: 
  * Deletion pipeline marks objects for immediate logical deletion, triggers KV cache purge, and schedules physical purge in 30 days.
  * Backup/escrow: raw backup windows (immutable snapshots) will have a 90-day retention by default; we can add an escrow commitment with controlled access for SpiralStack's GC under an NDA.
  * Audit trail & webhook: yes — deletion confirmation events (job id + timestamp + object namespace) are logged and we can emit a webhook to your endpoint. Sample event schema and a test webhook will be provided during the sprint.

Next steps I will:
1) Lock the two-week evidence sprint start: 2027-04-05.
2) Create Jira Epics for SOC2, SIG evidence, and DPA redline owners (links in related_links).
3) Upload region control note (jonas) and a short webhook sample (kimberly) by 2027-03-25.

If procurement needs a narrower acceptance window for PO we can introduce a canary sign-off (SOC2 controls + SIG network diagram) by 2027-04-12 for conditional PO. Let me know if that helps.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out quickly.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Manager, Solutions
Redwood Inference
Attachments: evidence-routing-sheet.xlsx (see tab "owners"), draft-dpa-carveouts.docx (tracked), soc2-internal-snapshot.pdf
